name: Summer Studios at People's Light
description_short: Summer theatre sessions for students entering grade 2 through high school on People's Light's Malvern campus, taught by the professional company's teaching artists. One week Theatre Toolkit samplers try many theatre skills; two and three week ensembles create and perform an original play; teens can audition for a three week musical theatre Performance Lab.
refund_policy_summary: A 50% deposit is due at registration. Payments are fully refundable until 60 days before the program starts, 50% refundable from 60 to 30 days before, and not refundable within 30 days. Missed days are not prorated.

sessions.name: Theatre Toolkit, entering grades 2 to 4 (4 days)
Story Finders, entering grades 2 to 4 (2 weeks)
Theatre Toolkit, entering grades 8 to pre-college
World Builders, entering grades 5 to 8 (3 weeks)
Teen Performance Lab: The Roaring Twenties, grades 8 to pre-college (by audition)

notes: Prices are the regular 2026 rates; early bird through March 1 was $25 to $125 less (Toolkits $375 or $475, Story Finders $950, World Builders $1,300). Performance Lab price not posted. Hours 9:00 to 4:00; extended day 8:00 to 8:45 and 4:15 to 5:30 at $30 a week each, or $15 a day. Students bring lunch. Household and referral discounts of 10%. Most sessions need no audition; at most 24 students a session. The main page says Summer Studios 2027 details are coming soon.
